entries.description: Input/output alphabet is the 256 UTF-8 byte values; no tokenizer merges, no vocabulary.
Bounded recurrent working state; dimensions fixed by the architecture spec.

Memory keys are produced by a deterministic seeded random projection: the frozen memory encoder table (uniform in [-1,1), SplitMix64 stream tagged 'core.memory_encoder'), summed over hashed byte trigrams. No corpus statistics.
Learning-rate, bias-rate, epsilon, update-norm bound (delta rule) and rate, decay, trace, gain (Hebbian rule). Chosen on pilot seeds only and frozen before the main Phase 4 run.
Six teaching/control commands (teach, ask, correct, confirm, forget, repeat), the ' => ' delimiter, and control IDs BOS/EOS/PAD. Full list in model/bootstrap/seed.json.

Symbols, roles, and relation atoms are unit complex phasors with angles from SplitMix64 streams tagged by namespace and name; numbers use fractional-power encoding exp(i n theta) with a seeded base. Binding is elementwise complex multiplication.

Bounded statement/question grammar: about 45 function words, 8 comparatives (4 dimensions), number words zero-twenty, verb normalizations, and the pronoun 'it'. Content words are open. Operator semantics (class inclusion, transitivity, inheritance, comparison, arithmetic, temporal order, negation, conditionals) are programmed.
